universe.name: Deep-sea layered paper diorama
universe.why: Provides a tactile, fragile sense of the internet's physical infrastructure, emphasizing the vast, melancholic scale of the deep ocean against a tiny, glowing thread.
universe.look_bible: Layered paper diorama. Thick textured watercolor paper, translucent vellum water, glowing LED backlighting. Deep oceanic navy, stark white paper edges, and a sharp, glowing neon orange for data. Moody, directional underwater lighting, sharp shadows from the layered paper, glowing rim lights. Macro lens with shallow depth of field, highlighting the texture of the paper grain. Slow, deliberate camera language gliding over stacked, meticulously cut paper layers.
universe.penguin_render: A flat, multi-layered paper cut-out penguin. Black and white textured paper body, bright orange paper beak tip and oversized feet. Three thin, distinct paper strips stuck to the top of its head, slightly bent. Big white paper rings for eyes. Deadpan expression, quietly unlucky.
universe.music: Moody, undulating ambient electronic track. Deep, resonant synth pads that sound like submarine sonar, mixed with delicate, rhythmic clicks and rustling paper textures. Tempo is a slow, steady 90 BPM. Feels vast, slightly melancholy, and mysterious, like staring into the deep ocean.
